deductions_2024_25.name: Working from home – fixed rate method
eligibility: You worked from home to fulfil employment duties (not just occasionally checking emails).
You incurred additional running expenses as a result.
You keep a record of all hours worked from home for the year.
You have at least one bill/receipt for each type of expense covered.

can_also_claim: decline in value of office furniture/equipment separately

exclusions: Separate phone/internet/stationery claims when using this method.
deductions_2024_25.record_keeping: Full year log of hours worked from home + sample bills/receipts.
ui_prompts: How many hours did you work from home in 2024–25?

deductions_2024_25.name: Work-related car expenses
eligibility: You used your own car for work travel (excluding normal home-to-work commuting).
Travel directly between two jobs or between workplace and external work location.
exclusions: Commuting between home and regular workplace.
deductions_2024_25.record_keeping: Reasonable estimate of kms or valid logbook + receipts for actual costs if logbook method.
ui_prompts: Which method do you want to use: cents/km or logbook?
How many work kilometres did you travel?

deductions_2024_25.name: Mobile phone and internet (work use)
eligibility: You paid for the plan/service yourself.
You can show work-related use proportion.
Not already claimed under WFH fixed rate method.
exclusions: Double-claiming with WFH fixed rate for same hours.
deductions_2024_25.record_keeping: Itemised bills, diary over 4 weeks to show usage pattern.
ui_prompts: What % of your phone/internet use was work-related?

deductions_2024_25.name: Protective and occupation-specific clothing & laundry
eligibility: Protective clothing/footwear, compulsory uniforms, or occupation-specific clothing.
deductions_2024_25.record_keeping: Receipts for purchases; diary/records for laundry loads; keep receipts if over $150 laundry or $300 total work expenses.
ui_prompts: How many loads of work-only laundry?
How many loads of mixed-use laundry?

deductions_2024_25.name: Tools, equipment and other assets
eligibility: Asset is used mainly (>50%) for producing assessable income.
exclusions: Private portion of cost must be excluded.
ui_prompts: What was the cost of the item?

deductions_2024_25.name: Union fees and professional subscriptions
eligibility: Membership fees paid to a trade union or professional/industry association related to your current employment.
deductions_2024_25.record_keeping: Receipts or statements from the organisation.
ui_prompts: How much did you pay in union or professional fees?

deductions_2024_25.name: Self-education expenses
eligibility: Course must maintain or improve skills in your current employment OR be likely to increase your income in your current role.
exclusions: Initial education to get a new job
Self-education with no connection to current income.
ui_prompts: What type of course did you take?
How much did you spend on course fees and materials?

deductions_2024_25.name: Gifts and donations
eligibility: Donation must be to a registered Deductible Gift Recipient (DGR).
Donation must be $2 or more.
exclusions: Donations where you receive a material benefit (e.g., raffle ticket, dinner).
deductions_2024_25.record_keeping: Receipts for all claims except bucket donations up to $10 total.
ui_prompts: How much did you donate to DGR organisations?

deductions_2024_25.name: Personal super contributions (deductible)
eligibility: You made personal after-tax contributions to a complying super fund.
You lodged a valid notice of intent with your fund and received acknowledgment.
deductions_2024_25.record_keeping: Acknowledgment from super fund; payment records.
ui_prompts: How much did you contribute personally to super?

deductions_2024_25.name: Cost of managing tax affairs
eligibility: Expenses relate to managing your own tax affairs (tax agent/accountant fees, travel to see them, ATO interest/penalty management).
ui_prompts: How much did you pay in tax agent or accountant fees?

deductions_2024_25.name: Income protection insurance premiums
eligibility: Premiums for a policy that insures against loss of your employment income.
exclusions: Life insurance, trauma insurance, critical illness cover
ui_prompts: How much did you pay in income protection premiums?

deductions_2024_25.name: Interest, dividend and other investment deductions
eligibility: Expenses must be incurred in earning interest, dividends or other investment income.

examples: interest on money borrowed to invest

exclusions: Upfront planning fees unless carrying on an investment business.
deductions_2024_25.record_keeping: Loan statements, account fee statements, receipts.
ui_prompts: What type of investment expenses did you incur?
How much did you spend on these expenses?
